input.answer:
The gasoline index (Canada, not seasonally adjusted, 2002=100 basis as published in table 18-10-0004) rose 27.8% from September 2025 to September 2026.

Calculation: (267.6 − 209.4) / 209.4 = 58.2 / 209.4 = 0.2780, i.e. +27.8%.

Source: Statistics Canada Table 18-10-0004-01, Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted (Canada, Gasoline, vector 41691136). Values are index levels ("units" scalar), so the change is computed from the index points.
